children: Q2 results this week include HCLTech, RBL Bank and ICICI Prudential AMC on October 12, with 129 companies scheduled to announce September-quarter earnings

HCLTech, RBL Bank and ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company (AMC) are set to announce their second-quarter results for FY27 on Monday, October 12, as India's September-quarter earnings season gathers pace, with 129 companies scheduled to report their financial performance during the week.

Investors will focus on revenue growth, margins, profitability and management commentary for clues about corporate demand, technology spending, banking-sector performance and market conditions. The upcoming results follow the earnings season's opening last week, when Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) announced its quarterly numbers.

HCLTech is expected to report sequential revenue growth and an improvement in margins, with investors watching for any changes to its FY27 guidance. Estimates from HDFC Institutional Equities point to around 2 per cent quarter-on-quarter growth in constant-currency revenue and a 50-basis-point expansion in margins.

The brokerage expects HCL Tech's adjusted net profit to rise 14.7 per cent year-on-year to Rs 4,857 crore, while revenue is projected to increase 11.1 per cent to Rs 35,475 crore. Its earnings outlook will also be assessed against the pace of discretionary technology spending, demand across major client sectors and the potential impact of artificial intelligence-led pricing pressure. Investors will track commentary on engineering research and development, software services and demand from banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), manufacturing, communications, retail and healthcare clients. The possibility of a revision to the company's FY27 services revenue guidance is another key factor.

RBL Bank is expected to report a sharp year-on-year increase in profit, supported by growth in net interest income and lending. Motilal Oswal Financial Services estimates net profit at Rs 520 crore, up 189 per cent, and net interest income at Rs 2,090 crore, an increase of 35 per cent.

Loan growth, deposit mobilisation, margins and credit costs will be important indicators of the lender's performance. ICICI Prudential AMC is expected to report moderate profit growth alongside higher revenue. Kotak Institutional Equities projects a 4.8 per cent year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 875.90 crore and a 14 per cent rise in sales to Rs 1,619 crore.
Banks And IT Firms Lead Earnings Calendar

Beyond Monday's announcements, the weekly earnings calendar includes major private-sector lenders HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Axis Bank, along with IT companies Wipro, Tech Mahindra and Persistent Systems. Nestle India and Jio Financial Services are also scheduled to report their September-quarter results.

On Tuesday, October 13, companies expected to announce results include ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, Tata Elxsi and Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers. Wednesday's list includes Canara Bank, BHEL, HDB Financial Services, ICICI Lombard General Insurance and CEAT. Thursday, October 15, is expected to bring results from Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Persistent Systems, HDFC Life, HDFC Asset Management Company, Polycab India and L&T Finance, among others.

The results will offer investors a broader assessment of earnings momentum across banking, information technology, insurance, asset management and consumer businesses. Commentary on demand conditions, operating costs, credit quality and growth guidance is likely to shape stock-specific reactions through the week.
